verdict.rationale: The Card Expenses API lets you pull approved card expenses and mark them as synced after loading them into an ERP or accounting system. The Bills API, webhooks and spend reconciliation features could support a custom sync pipeline. But this is a build-it-yourself API path, not an automatic sync with accounting software. Missing for 10: native connectors to named accounting packages (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite), automatic sync of general account transactions beyond card expenses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
